name: Fresh Broccoli Mandarin Salad
description: A refreshing salad featuring fresh broccoli, mandarin oranges, mushrooms, and a rich, creamy dressing with a hint of mustard.
recipeIngredient: 1 egg plus 1 egg yolk, slightly beaten
½ medium red onion, sliced into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In the top of a double boiler, whisk together the egg, egg yolk, sugar, cornstarch, and mustard.
Slowly whisk in the vinegar and water mixture, then cook over hot water, stirring constantly, until the dressing thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the softened butter and mayonnaise. Chill the dressing.
Just before serving, combine the crumbled bacon, mushrooms, almonds, mandarin oranges, red onion, and broccoli in a large salad bowl.
Add the chilled dressing and toss to coat the salad ingredients evenly.
Refrigerate any leftovers.

keywords: broccoli mandarin salad, creamy dressing, fresh salad

_similar.name: Mandarin Orange Salad
_similar.description: A classic spinach and lettuce salad with mandarin oranges and toasted almonds, dressed with a sweet and tangy homemade vinaigrette.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash and clean the romaine lettuce, red tip lettuce, and spinach. Dry thoroughly and rip into bite-sized pieces.
In a saucepan, combine sugar, vinegar, mustard, and salt. Bring to a boil, then allow to cool.
Once cooled, blend the dressing mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the dressing over the prepared lettuce mixture about 10 minutes before serving.
Just before serving, add the drained mandarin oranges and toasted slivered almonds.

_similar.keywords: mandarin orange salad, spinach salad, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Tossed Berry-Mandarin Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing mixed greens salad with strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion, and bacon, topped with a homemade honey-cider dressing.
recipeIngredient: 1 medium sweet onion, sliced and separated into rings

recipeInstructions.text: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine sugar, cider vinegar, honey, lemon juice, paprika, mustard, grated onion, celery seed, and salt.
Microwave uncovered on high for 1½ to 2 minutes, stirring until the sugar is dissolved.
Whisk in vegetable oil until well combined. Refrigerate until chilled.
In a large serving bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced strawberries, mandarin oranges, sweet onion rings, toasted almonds, and crumbled bacon.
Drizzle the chilled dressing over the salad and gently toss to coat.

_similar.keywords: fruit salad, mixed greens, strawberry, mandarin orange, bacon

_similar.name: Salad Dressing
_similar.description: A thickened salad dressing made by boiling a mixture of eggs, sugar, flour, mustard, water, and vinegar, finished with butter.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs and add sugar and dry ingredients.
Boil water and vinegar together.
Pour egg mixture into vinegar-water mixture and boil until it thickens, stirring continually.
Take off heat and stir in 1 Tbsp butter.
